text:
arya: heads-up, sudden mTLS verify failures in eu-north around 07:02 UTC after the new region-scoped IAM bind landed. seeing lots of 'bad certificate' in proxies.

arya: ```edge-proxy-eu-north.log: 2026-04-12T07:03:11Z ERROR tls handshake failed: remote error: tls: bad certificate, verify error: certificate signed by unknown authority (CN=svc-ingress)```

kevin: can you paste the IAM change audit? suspect conditional binding excluded regional proxy SAs.

arya: audit snippet:

arya: ```iam.audit: 2026-04-12T07:01:05Z BIND principal=infra-deploy@redwood role=roles/keystore.decrypt condition=expr:"request.region == 'us-central1'"```

mike: that condition only allows us-central; eu-north proxies can't decrypt wrapping keys so rotator couldn't unwrap -> stale certs presented.

kevin: ops-bot, create incident and mute noisy alerts. I'll revert the bind now.

ops-bot: Incident INC-20260412-regional-keystore created by kevin. Severity: P2. Alerts muted for eu-north.

audit-bot: KMS Deny spike detected: 92 denies in 7m for projects/keystore (threshold=10).

mike: rolling IAM revert: removing the region condition so rotator SA can decrypt across regions.

mike: revert applied at 07:06 UTC. certbot, can you restart rotator for eu-north?

certbot: Automated: rotator job queued job-id=rot-20260412-eun-0707. Will attempt rewrap if KMS allows.

arya: after revert, handshake errors dropped back to baseline by 07:11. rotator reported success for 6/6 nodes.

kevin: follow-ups: 1) don't use literal region equality in IAM conditions for keystore.decrypt; use allowlist claim that includes env+region OR rely on delegated role mapping. 2) add CI test matrix: region-scoped bindings + impersonation + KMS decrypt. 3) ensure KMS audit includes effective principal + impersonation chain and region claim.

mike: i'll add a runbook step: when KMS Deny for decrypt role > 20/min and TLS handshake errors > 5% in same region, consider immediate IAM revert (with one-click approval).

arya: security note: these conditional bindings are useful but brittle across multi-region service identities. add to design doc.

kevin: filing tickets for CI and audit changes. closing thread after postmortem link is attached.
